_doc: The 3D models of the Store (#1701), declared data: gen-store.py merges each into data/store.json as a world of Type Model. The models are the owner's own files published in the public LFS repo diegonmarcos/hardtech-db-models (the same originals and GLB views Hardtech-CAD MCAD declares in its models.json, #1695); this app never bakes a model file: the viewer (assets/model) downloads the GLB view from `glb.url` at runtime, checks its SHA-256 and keeps it in the page's cache, and the Store card loads `photo` the same way. `repo_url` is the repo's page (open in browser). A model's GLB is a derived, triangulated view in metres, Y-up, one node per part or material; the original (OBJ / STEP) stays in the originals repo (`original`).

models.name: House Boat
models.framework: three.js / glTF (GLB view of a Wavefront OBJ)
models.description: Two-deck pontoon houseboat, the owner's own model: 5 materials, 23,652 triangles, 9.15 x 5.65 x 5.0 m. Rotate, zoom and auto-rotate; the original OBJ stays in the originals repo.

models.name: DJI S900
models.framework: three.js / glTF (GLB view of a STEP AP214 assembly)
models.description: Hex-rotor camera drone, the owner's own SolidWorks assembly: 237 parts in 15 colours, 166,007 triangles, 0.87 x 0.59 x 0.91 m. Rotate, zoom and auto-rotate; the original STEP (22 MB) stays in the originals repo.
